_description: P-wave travel time inversion for earthquake source localization from public seismic data
_groundspring_question: Can we locate an earthquake source from noisy arrival-time observations?
_data_source: IRIS Web Services (free, public, no key) — https://service.iris.edu/

travel_time_model._description: 1D layered velocity model for continental crust (IASP91-simplified)
travel_time_model._reference: Kennett & Engdahl (1991) IASP91, Geophysical Journal International

test_scenario._description: Synthetic earthquake with known location, for validation of inversion
test_scenario._note: Arrival time noise of ±0.5s is realistic for automated P-wave picks

noise_characterization._description: Types of noise in seismic data

ocean_microseism.description: Continuous ground motion from ocean waves
